collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager strings tiny shells into a necklace for no particular reason.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (subject) strings tiny shells into a necklace for no particular reason. (subject) wears it to the stream and feels quietly pleased all day.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (subject) strings tiny shells into a necklace for no particular reason. (friend) admires it, and (subject) gives it away on the spot.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (subject) strings tiny shells into a necklace for no particular reason. The string breaks, and the shells scatter across the hut floor.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (subject) strings tiny shells into a necklace for no particular reason. (subject) decides to make a matching one, and then another.
